common: Production texture for a Civilization IV civilization banner, a flat square heraldic emblem. Large emblem centered in central 70 percent with generous plain field margins. Thick clear shapes legible downscaled to 128x128 pixels. Clean flat vector-like shapes and solid colors. No lettering, no writing, no calligraphy, no border, no fabric, no folds, no pole, no lighting or 3D. Full square opaque image.

designs.name: Arabia
designs.design: Original Arabia: imposing deep blood-red field, two large crossed golden curved scimitars, blades pointed up and out, small bold gold eight-point sun above the crossing. Powerful martial medieval heraldic design.

designs.name: Abbasid
designs.design: Abbasid successor realm: jet-black field, a large golden eight-point geometric rosette enclosing a smaller gold ring, four simple gold dots at the cardinal directions. Dignified medieval Islamic court geometry.

designs.name: Fatimid
designs.design: Fatimid successor realm: warm ivory field, a large emerald-green circular medallion with a bold interlaced eight-point geometric star, small gold center. Elegant medieval Egyptian Islamic ornament.

designs.name: Umayyad
designs.design: Umayyad successor realm in Iberia and the Maghreb: warm ivory field, one bold crimson horseshoe arch framing a stylized golden palm with crimson trunk, simple balanced Andalusian ornament.
